mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2.0% holds for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate profit expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% holds for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST > 1150) and weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a demand-supply mismatch where housing demand is outpacing supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1150 and INDPRO < 100 hold for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In low interest rate environments (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, INDPRO declines by more than 1% in the prior month but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Higher levels of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicate elevated inflation, which erodes real equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 245 holds for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1150) signals robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1150 holds for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation is high (CPIAUCSL > 247) and the federal funds rate is not accommodative (FEDFUNDS > 1.5), the combination signals a persistent inflationary environment that prompts monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 247 and FEDFUNDS > 1.5 hold for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts corporate profit expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 4.5%, PAYEMS rises by more than 10,000 in the prior month but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of such instances.
